description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
description.en:
A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value from your client for each request. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters.

description.zh: Zone ID。Zone ID，Zone的唯一识别码。
description.en: The unique ID of the zone.

descriptions.zh: 如果被删除的解析记录中存在锁定解析，则该锁定解析不会被删除。
descriptions.en: If a zone contains locked DNS records, this operation does not delete them.
